description: Deep in a digital-age bunker, a rogue cryptographer left behind a trail of increasingly sophisticated codes. From simple shifts to layered encryptions, each puzzle builds on the last. Crack them all to unlock the cache.

levels.title: Boot Sector
hints: 💻 Convert the binary stream into hex to pass the firewall.
💻 Group the bits into nibbles (4 bits) then read each as hex.
💻 The answer is A.
